errors.evidence: The Y-axis is not explicitly labeled. The chart's title is "CV". While the paper's figure caption mentions "σ-конвергенцията", stating that the axis is labeled "σ" is an incorrect assumption.
The final value of the solid line in 2019 is approximately 0.28, not 0.29.

errors.evidence: This description of the dotted trendline is entirely incorrect. The line does not start at 0.34 (it starts at approx. 0.36) and it does not remain stable. It shows a clear, steady, linear decrease from approximately 0.36 in 2009 to below 0.30 in 2019. The final value is not 0.32, and there is no sudden drop after 2018.
